what: Figure 5 (a)/(b): inverse power law fits (Figueroa 2012) of the in-domain learning curves, with case-clustered bootstrap intervals over the fit, asymptotes, N to 95/97 % of the asymptote and to the absolute targets, matched-accuracy exchange rates, and the collection recommendation's inputs

citation.authors: Figueroa RL, Zeng-Treitler Q, Kandula S, Ngo LH
citation.title: Predicting sample size required for classification performance
citation.verified: 2026-09-24 against the PMC full text (PMC3307431): Y = 1 - a - b x^c, c in [-1, 0]; weighted nonlinear least squares (nl2sol), weight j/m for the j-th smallest sample size; confidence intervals from the Hessian

model: acc(N) = A - B * N^(-C); A = asymptote; fitted on N > 0 by weighted NLS with Figueroa's rank weights j/m; multi-start; bounds A in [0,1], B in [0,100], C in [0,6]

intervals.primary: case-clustered percentile bootstrap over the whole fit: resample test patients with replacement (shared draw across curves and seeds, hits and truth summed over seeds within a patient), recompute every point, refit; 2.5/97.5 percentiles over the finite replicates; 'not reached' counted
intervals.secondary: Figueroa's Hessian (asymptotic) interval on the asymptote, from the Jacobian covariance scaled by the reduced chi-square; unreliable at dof 1-3, reported for the record

detection.note: C-ArmLSpine released test split, repaired truth; LAT 27 patients / 138 vertebrae, AP 28 / 143 per seed

naming.note: the five case-grouped test folds pooled (every C-ArmLSpine case with a matched vertebra is in exactly one test fold)

detection.source: tools/eval_gate.py verdict stamped in every dump (detfill/grid/percase.json) + the list intersection of tools/lcurve_fill.py heldout in det_fill.json

naming.source: tools/eval_gate.py verdict stamped in every det_score_k*.json (fit/name_percase.json) + heldout_lists per cell in name_fill.json

heldout.note: this tool fits numbers already scored; it trains nothing and touches no test image. Every curve point is a held-out cell by both checks.
